name: frommwah
description: Turn a gift you have chosen, as a photo or a product link, and a personal message into an animated Frommwah gift box, and get a link to share.

interface.shortDescription: Send any gift as a surprise
interface.longDescription:
Frommwah turns a gift you have chosen into a small personal surprise you can send by link. Tell ChatGPT who the gift is for and either attach a photo of the gift or give a link to a product page, add a personal message of up to 150 characters, and pick a box colour. Frommwah makes an animated gift box and gives you a link to share by text, WhatsApp or email.

ChatGPT can help you decide what to give. Frommwah does not search for or recommend products: once you have chosen, Frommwah creates the gift reveal.

When the person opens the link on their phone or computer, they see the box open, the gift come out of it, and your message appear. If you gave a product link, they also get a button to open that page. There is nothing to install and they do not need an account.

Suited to birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, thank-you gifts, romantic surprises and last-minute gifts.

Product links: if you give a link and no photo, Frommwah reads that product page to find the product's name and main picture, saves a copy of the picture with your gift, and makes a cut-out version so it can pop out of the box. The picture belongs to its owner and is used only to show your gift. Whether a picture can be found depends on the shop: some shops cannot be read. If that happens, ChatGPT tells you and offers a photo or screenshot of the gift, or a box that shows just the product's name, and only makes one if you agree.

What it does: creates one personal gift box per request, in Frommwah's own box colours (black and gold, cream, pink, red, green, blue, purple, teal or silver), with the recipient's first name, an optional sender name, your photo or the product picture, an optional link to the gift with its name, and an optional message. It returns the share link and a small preview.

What it does not do: it does not make shop-branded boxes with a store's logo (those belong to Frommwah's separate apps for shop owners). It does not buy anything, take payments, deliver anything, send the gift for you, search for or recommend products, or handle card details, passwords, voucher codes or tickets, and it should not be used for them. Gifts are shared by link only; you choose how and when to send it. Voice notes are not part of the ChatGPT experience.

For a photo, please use a picture of the gift itself, not of people.
defaultPrompt: I found an anniversary gift for my girlfriend. Help me turn it into a surprise I can send.
Make my dad's birthday present a fun reveal, with a short message from me.
Last-minute Christmas gift for my sister: make something I can text her today.

positive.description: Personal gift box from a photo, with a message
positive.prompt: I have attached a photo of a pair of walking boots. Make a Frommwah gift box for my dad Paul's birthday with the message 'Happy birthday Dad, enjoy!'
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the user to confirm the write action, then calls create_gift_box with recipient Paul, the message and the attached photo. A preview card says a gift box for Paul was made, with an Open the reveal button, and ChatGPT gives a frommwah.com share link. Opening the link shows the box opening, the photo coming out of it and the message.

positive.description: Gift box from a product link only (no photo)
positive.prompt: Make a gift box for my sister Amy's birthday from this product page: https://www.johnlewis.com/skandinavisk-still-waters-scented-candle-gift-set/p113032791 with the message 'Happy birthday Amy, you deserve this!'
positive.expected_behavior: create_gift_box is called with recipient Amy, the message and the product link, with no photo. The server reads that product page, finds its name and main picture, saves a copy of the picture and makes a cut-out of it. The share link opens a reveal in which the product picture comes out of the box, the message appears, and a View product button goes to the original John Lewis page.

positive.description: ChatGPT helps choose, the user picks, Frommwah creates the reveal
positive.prompt: I've chosen the Skandinavisk Still Waters candle gift set from John Lewis for my sister Amy: https://www.johnlewis.com/skandinavisk-still-waters-scented-candle-gift-set/p113032791 . Turn it into a birthday reveal I can text her.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT uses the product link the user chose and calls create_gift_box. Frommwah does not suggest or search for products; it only creates the gift reveal and returns the share link.

positive.description: Gift box with a photo and a link to the gift
positive.prompt: I have attached a photo of a scarf. Make a Frommwah gift box for my sister Amy. The gift is called Wool scarf and it is here: https://example.com/wool-scarf
positive.expected_behavior: create_gift_box is called with the photo, the link and the title Wool scarf. The share link opens a reveal that shows the photo and a View product button that goes to the link. Because a photo was given, the server does not read the link's page.

positive.description: Choosing a box colour and a sender name
positive.prompt: I have attached a photo of a gift. Make a teal Frommwah box for Priya, from Jo, with the message 'Thank you for everything'.
positive.expected_behavior: create_gift_box is called with box colour teal and sender Jo. The preview card shows the teal box, says the gift is from Jo, and the reveal link uses the teal box.

negative.description: Buying and delivering a product is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy this watch for my brother and have it delivered to his house.

negative.description: Voucher codes and other secrets must not go in a gift box
negative.prompt: Put my voucher code AB12-CD34 in a Frommwah gift box for Tom.

negative.description: Gift ideas alone are not a request to make a gift box
negative.prompt: What should I buy my wife for our anniversary?

review.commerce_description: Frommwah in ChatGPT does not sell anything or take payments, subscriptions or credits, and does not deliver anything. A link the user adds is a plain link to the retailer's own page, opened by the person who receives the gift. Frommwah does not add an affiliate tag to the link.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.2. A gift can now be made from a product link alone. Frommwah reads the product page to find the product's name and main picture, saves a copy of the picture with the gift and makes a cut-out of it so it can pop out of the box. ChatGPT may help the user choose a gift; Frommwah does not search for or recommend products. Some shops cannot be read: ChatGPT then offers a photo or screenshot, or a box that shows just the product's name. Photo gifts work exactly as before. No purchases, payments, deliveries, accounts, voice notes or product search.
